exposure: Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) classified according to Jordans et al.
outcome: Treatment success rate of medical management (methotrexate)
Treatment success rate of surgical management
Neonatal outcomes in expectantly managed pregnancies
finding: The CSP classification by Jordans et al. appears to be clinically useful, with Type 1 and Type 2 CSP often managed successfully with less invasive medical approaches, while Type 3 CSP frequently requires surgical resection.
